title: Vital Salt Nic E-Liquid – Strawberry Orange Mango 60ml
description:
Introducing Strawberry Orange Mango by Vital 60, an e-liquid that offers a delicious and unique blend of three fruity flavours – strawberry, orange, and mango. This e-juice is perfect for vapers who want a sweet and fruity vape experience that is both refreshing and satisfying.
With every puff, you’ll taste the sweet and tangy flavours of strawberry and orange, which are perfectly balanced by the refreshing and juicy taste of mango. These flavours come together in perfect harmony to create a delicious and unique vaping experience that you won’t be able to get enough of.
Made with only the highest quality ingredients, Strawberry Orange Mango by Vital 60 offers a smooth and satisfying vape that is free from any harshness or bitterness. This e-liquid is perfect for those who want a sweet and fruity vape that is both delicious and refreshing.
The e-liquid comes in a 60ml bottle, which is the perfect size for vaping on the go. The sleek and stylish design of the bottle makes it easy to carry with you wherever you go, so you can enjoy the sweet and fruity taste of Strawberry Orange Mango by Vital 60 whenever you want.
Strawberry Orange Mango by Vital 60 is also available in different nicotine strengths, so you can choose the level of nicotine that best suits your needs. This e-liquid is perfect for those who are looking for a fruity and sweet vape experience that is both refreshing and satisfying.
Flavour Notes:
Strawberry
Orange
Mango
50 VG 50 PG
